class.name: FmodAudioServer
class.brief_description: FmodAudioServer is a high level interface for interacting with the FMOD api. Integrated with godot;

method.name: any_sample_data_loading
method.description: if [code]true[/code] sample data in a bank or event is currently loading.

method.name: get_singleton
method.description: Returns the FmodAudioServer instance.

method.name: get_version_number
method.description: Returns the FMOD Version number.

method.name: has_bank_loaded
method.description: if [code]true[/code] [param bank_name] is loaded. returns false if bank does not exist

method.name: have_all_banks_loaded
method.description: if [code]true[/code] all banks have finished loading.

method.name: path_to_guid
method.description: Returns the guid of the [param path]. [b]Note:[/b] The Strings banks must be loaded

method.name: play_one_shot_2d_attached_by_id
method.description: Plays and attaches fmod event (from [param guid]) to [param node]. Tracks position and optionally velocity.

method.name: play_one_shot_2d_attached_by_path
method.description: Plays and attaches fmod event (from [param path]) to [param node]. Tracks position and optionally velocity. [b]Note:[/b] The Strings banks must be loaded

method.name: play_one_shot_3d_attached_by_id
method.description: Plays and attaches fmod event (from [param guid]) to [param node]. Tracks position and optionally velocity.

method.name: play_one_shot_3d_attached_by_path
method.description: Plays and attaches fmod event (from [param path]) to [param node]. Tracks position and optionally velocity. [b]Note:[/b] The Strings banks must be loaded

method.name: play_one_shot_by_id
method.description: Plays one shot event at [param position] in world space (from [param guid]). In 2D Z is normally zero [b]Note:[/b] In 2D if you want the sound to align with the XY plane Z should be zero

method.name: play_one_shot_by_path
method.description: Plays one shot event at [param position] in world space (from [param guid]). In 2D Z is normally zero [b]Note:[/b] In 2D if you want the sound to align with the XY plane Z should be zero [b]Note:[/b] The Strings banks must be loaded

method.name: play_one_shot_rigid_2d_attached_by_path
method.description: Plays one shot event (from [param path]) and attaches it to [param rigid_body2d]. Tracks position and velocity [b]Note:[/b] The Strings banks must be loaded

method.name: play_one_shot_rigid_body2d_attached_by_id
method.description: Plays one shot event (from [param guid]) and attaches it to [param rigid_body2d]. Tracks position and velocity

method.name: play_one_shot_rigid_body3d_attached_by_id
method.description: Plays one shot event (from [param guid]) and attaches it to [param rigid_body3d]. Tracks position and velocity

method.name: play_one_shot_rigid_body3d_attached_by_path
method.description: Plays one shot event (from [param path]) and attaches it to [param rigid_body3d]. Tracks position and velocity [b]Note:[/b] The Strings banks must be loaded

method.name: set_listener_2d_location
method.description: Copies [param attenuation_object]'s transform to listener's attributes

method.name: set_listener_2d_rigidbody_location
method.description: Copies [param attenuation_object]'s transform and velocity to listener's attributes

method.name: set_listener_3d_location
method.description: Copies [param attenuation_object]'s transform to listener's attributes

method.name: set_listener_3d_rigidbody_location
method.description: Copies [param attenuation_object]'s transform and velocity to listener's attributes

method.name: unload_banks
method.description: Unloads all banks. [b]Warning:[/b] This ignores the reference count of banks loaded as resources and can lead to audio bugs.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], All fmod sounds are muted.
